answers.rationale: The effective_rate relation establishes job J1 at 240 currency units per hour (TOW service code, per service conditions §1).
Although J4's tow_job service_code is ASST, effective_rate maps it to the ESCORT rate_card row at 180 per hour (service conditions §4).

Seven tow jobs exist but only four have rows in billable_hours (J1–J4). J5, J6, and J7 lack an established billable-hours quantity—J6 due to blank billed_hours and J5/J7 due to unresolved B12 after-hours berth restrictions.
job_charge establishes J2 at 2280: 8 hours at 240/hr plus 1 hour overtime at 1.5× (vessel V-BAY day total 9h > 8; service conditions §2).
No relation in the World records a fuel surcharge for any job. J3's job_charge of 240 is explained solely as 2h at 120/hr with no surcharge component.

J7 is at berth B12 starting at 20:00 (after 18:00). billing_outcome marks it insufficient_evidence because B12 after-hours commercial towing lacks emergency documentation, and purpose_requirement_failure records EXPLICIT_UNRESOLVED for berth_b12_after_hours on J7.
